_comment: Per-tool image-pool spec for ten-frame activities. Keys are pre-verified to exist at /var/www/lcs-media/image-library/<theme>/<key>.png AND /var/www/lcs-media/image-library-webp/themes/<theme>/<key>@2x.webp. Themes here are color-only per the §A.B&W exclusion rule (axisKey does NOT end in '_bw' AND no locale's displayName ends in its BW marker).
